Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Store].[USA].[Calc] AS '1' MEMBER [Measures].[c1] AS 'Count([Store].CurrentMember.Children)' MEMBER [Measures].[c2] AS '[Store].CurrentMember.Children.Count' MEMBER [Measures].[c3] AS 'AddCalculatedMembers([Store].CurrentMember.Children).Count' MEMBER [Measures].[c4] AS 'Count([Store].CurrentMember.Children, EXCLUDEEMPTY)' MEMBER [Measures].[c5] AS 'Count(AddCalculatedMembers([Product].CurrentMember.Children))' MEMBER [Measures].[c6] AS 'Count([Store].[All Stores].Children) + Count([Store].Parent.Children)' SELECT {[Measures].[c1], [Measures].[c2], [Measures].[c3], [Measures].[c4], [Measures].[c5], [Measures].[c6]} ON COLUMNS, {[Store].[All Stores], [Store].[USA], [Store].[USA].[Calc], [Store].[USA].[CA], [Store].[USA].[CA].[San Francisco], [Store].[USA].[CA].[San Francisco].[Store 14], [Store].[Mexico]} ON ROWS FROM [ZFMSALES]
